title: cadintent core command payloads
description: Payload schemas for the core command kinds. The envelope's 'kind' selects which payload schema applies; each payload def carries an 'x-cadintent-command' annotation declaring its kind name, allowed author roles, and basis requiredness ('required' = basis must be non-empty; 'optional' = may be empty). Packs specialize the generic object.* shapes and may only tighten these declarations. Spec version 0.1.0.

ImportRef.description: An exact-version pin of an imported artifact (rule registry or presentation pack).

ProjectUnitsPayload.description: Declares the project's unit system. Required before any design-content command (missing_declaration otherwise); declared exactly once and immutable for the life of the log (immutable_declaration on re-declaration).

ProjectCrsPayload.description: Declares the CRS the project's local plane corresponds to. Metadata only; optional, re-declarable, latest-wins.

RegistryImportPayload.description: Imports a rule-registry version into the project. Additive and repeatable; each import pins an exact version and is never retracted or mutated. An import must precede any command citing it.

PresentationImportPayload.description: Imports a presentation-pack version into the project. Same additive, version-pinned machinery as registry.import.

RuleDefinePayload.description: Creates a project-local rule-registry entry, status 'unverified'. Anyone (typically an agent) may author it; basis is required and its statement citation ancestry is permanent — basis is immutable, so the entry's lineage back to the engineer's words never breaks. The entry is cited as {registry: 'project', version: <seq of this command>, name, params} — the same citation shape as shipped registries, pinned by the log itself.

params.description: JSON Schema for the rule's parameter object (see registry.json RuleEntry).

semantics.description: Normative human-readable description of the derivation.

value.description: The quantized constant value for constant-valued entries (e.g. a taught minimum).

RuleVerifyPayload.description: Flips the latest project-local rule entry with this name to 'verified'. Engineer-only — verification is itself a logged fact with author, time, and basis; the author-role restriction is enforced at fold, not policy. Verifying a name with no project-local entry refuses (unknown_reference).

SelectionGroup.description: One named group within a selection, referenced later as '<selection ULID>#<name>'.

ExplicitSelectionCriteria.description: The v0 minimal criteria shape: an explicit object list with optional named groups. The full criteria vocabulary (predicates over layers, regions, classification by offset, ...) is deliberately unmapped; future criteria kinds extend the SelectionCriteria union.

SelectionCriteria.description: What a selection selects. v0 ships only the explicit kind; membership is resolved at replay and recorded in the derivation record.

SelectionDefinePayload.description: Creates or redefines a selection: a first-class object defined by criteria, carrying its own author-minted ULID. Mutates no design fact; exempt from the scope audit.

object.description: The selection's own ULID, minted by the author.

QuantityAttr.description: A quantized decimal quantity; which quantum applies is declared by the object kind's attribute schema (pack-owned).

ReferenceAttr.description: A reference-valued attribute: another object's ULID, never a derived name.

AttrMap.description: Attribute name -> typed value. Which names are meaningful for an object kind is pack-owned; the kernel stores what lands.

ObjectCreatePayload.description: Creates a design object. 'type' names the object kind (pack-defined, e.g. 'civil.manhole'); whether 'ends' / 'networks' are meaningful is declared by that kind's topology category. Packs specialize this shape.

object.description: The new object's ULID, minted by the author.

type.description: The object kind name, dotted like command kinds (e.g. 'civil.manhole').

ObjectSetAttrsPayload.description: Sets facts on an existing object (or each member of a selection/group): attribute values, geometry, edge-end bindings, or network membership. Only the fields present are written.

ObjectRemovePayload.description: Removes an object (or each member of a selection/group). Removing a still-referenced object refuses with dangling_reference; rewire or remove dependents in the same submission.
